Jack and Sam are in the same class. I am happy every day. Sam likes rice too. What's more, the horse runs fast.
The green hill is not far from my home. The bird-watching spot is big and clean. My friend Sam is very kind. The lion rested under a shady tree.
I like my life very much. Jack wants to visit Sydney. Jack's favorite season is winter.
